stem: Which question is most relevant to an ecosystem beginning primary succession?

options.label: A
options.text: Why is there no soil, grass, or shrubs present in the ecosystem?

options.label: B
options.text: Why are there so many kinds of animals living in the ecosystem?

options.label: C
options.text: What types of hardwood trees are growing in the ecosystem?

options.label: D
options.text: What caused the forest fire that destroyed the previous ecosystem?
